title: How People's Blockchain works
loopLine: People use the network. Usage creates fees. Part of every fee flows back to the community.

items.title: Wallet
items.text: Create a non-custodial wallet (12-word phrase) on your phone or in a browser, or sign in with Google for a synced wallet. With the 12-word wallet, keys never leave your device.

items.title: Create a token
items.text: Pick a name, ticker, image and supply, and pay in PPL. It's priced on a bonding curve from the first trade.

items.title: Trade
items.text: Buy and sell on the launch curve, then in the token/PPL pool.

items.title: 10% to the community
items.text: Every standard token sends 10% of its supply to its own community pool.

items.title: Curve leftovers
items.text: After the curve migrates to the AMM — or if it is finalized after 180 days without selling out — leftover and unsold tokens follow the creator's launch choice: burned by default (recommended), or sent to that token's community pool. Never to the creator or the protocol treasury. Every standard token also sends 10% of supply to its community pool at launch.

items.title: Optional referral share
items.text: At launch, a creator may opt into an issuer referral program: by default 5% of supply (maximum 10%) can be reserved for invite rewards, with a default invite bounty of 5% of the invitee's purchase. Off until the creator opts in.

items.title: Creator vesting
items.text: The creator's share unlocks over 180 days, so there's no dump on day one.

items.title: One-tap participation sessions from your phone.
Participation points decide your share of community rewards. They can't be bought or transferred.

blocks.title: Fixed PPL supply
blocks.intro: One billion PPL, no surprise minting in the early years. Validators and launch rewards come from genesis buckets and fees.
bullets: Years 1–4: 0% inflation — supply stays at 1B PPL.
Validators: 200M PPL pool paid 6% / 5% / 5% / 4% of total supply per year (60M, 50M, 50M, 40M) plus 30% of network fees.
Founders, bounties, ambassadors and airdrops: only from the 35% community pool.
From year 5: at most 2% new emission per year, community vote only.
Founders airdrop first; public sale after 1,000 verified people and a multisig.
Every protocol fee: 30% validators, 25% community pool, 20% treasury, 10% liquidity, 15% Growth Pool, 0% burn.

blocks.title: Where rewards come from
blocks.intro: Every network fee is paid in PPL and split the same way every time:
blocks.communityPoolExample: The Community Pool is shared among active participants in proportion to their participation points. Here's an example: the pool has 600 tokens and three people hold 1, 2 and 3 points, so they get 100, 200 and 300.
blocks.tokenPoolNote: Separately, each token's 10% community share stays in that token's own pool. It is never mixed with PPL fees.
blocks.buybackNote: The treasury and liquidity shares (30% combined) fund public PPL buybacks from the open market, run by the published multisig and visible in the explorer.
blocks.launchFeeNote: Launching a token or NFT costs a protocol fee, payable in PPL or in a supported stablecoin (USDC/USDT) — your choice. Gas is always paid in PPL.

blocks.title: Why bots can't farm it
blocks.body: New accounts start slow, inactive accounts fade, and every person has a cap. A hundred fake accounts don't earn a hundred times more.

blocks.title: The honest part
bullets: Rewards aren't fixed. No activity means no rewards.
Token prices can go up, down, or to zero.
This is participation in a network, not an investment.
